# Gaudi Cookbook

> Tested recipes, runtime fixes, kernels and fleet practices for serving open LLMs with vLLM on Intel Gaudi 2 through the vllm-gaudi plugin. Gaudi software 1.24.1, vllm-gaudi v0.26.0 and releases/v0.30.0, lazy mode.

Agents: read AGENTS.md first. It maps tasks to files and gives the rules: check the image before patching, keep verified and untested apart, and ask before touching shared hardware. The links below point at raw Markdown and YAML.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/AGENTS.md): where to look for each task, how to turn a recipe into a command, and the rules.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/getting-started.md): software baseline, image build steps, container flags.
- [Recipe format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/recipes/README.md): the recipe.yaml schema and its gaudi block.
- [Fixes contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/README.md): how the fix pack applies, profiles, exit codes, adding a fix.

## Fixes

- [Fix index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/fixes/index.md): status table with affected setups, releases, profiles and upstream links.
- [prompt-order](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/prompt-order/README.md): Run a step's prompts in order of context length, so a prefix-cache hit is never read before the request that computes it has written it. Affects: every model served with prefix caching (the default).
- [sampling-rows-refresh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/sampling-rows-refresh/README.md): Re-copy the device-side sampling parameters after the input batch reorders its rows, so every request is sampled with its own temperature, top-p, top-k, min-p and penalties. Affects: every model, whenever concurrent requests use different sampling parameters.
- [structured-output-rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/structured-output-rows/README.md): Sample each row of a structured-output step with its own request's sampling parameters. Affects: every model, in any step that has a request with a grammar.
- [so-row-owners](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/so-row-owners/README.md): Give grammar masks, sampling parameters and logprobs to the logits rows that actually exist in a structured-output step. Affects: every model, in steps with a grammar request and a partial prompt chunk.
- [bad-words-index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/bad-words-index/README.md): Key `bad_words` to the rows that are actually being sampled, so one request's `bad_words` can neither stop the engine nor ban tokens on another request's output. Affects: every model, whenever a request sets `bad_words`.
- [logitsprocs-rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/logitsprocs-rows/README.md): Make the `min_p`, `logit_bias` and `min_tokens` request options take effect on HPU. Affects: every model, whenever a request sets `min_p`, `logit_bias` or `min_tokens`.
- [async-inputs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/async-inputs/README.md): Seed the device decode input ids from the host before the async-scheduling scatter, so a decode request that sat out a step does not read a stale token. Affects: every model served with async scheduling.
- [async-discard-counter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/async-discard-counter/README.md): Make the HPU async scheduler use vLLM's `async_tokens_to_discard` counter, so a preempted request no longer stops the engine with an `AttributeError`. Affects: every model served with async scheduling (the default) when a request is preempted.
- [resumed-prefill-logits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/resumed-prefill-logits/README.md): Sample one token, not one per recomputed position, when a request resumes after preemption with prefix-cache hits. Affects: every model served with prefix caching, when requests are preempted.
- [hybrid-decode-pad](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/hybrid-decode-pad/README.md): Keep decode padding out of live KV blocks on hybrid models whose attention KV block is split into smaller kernel blocks. Affects: hybrid models (GDN, linear attention or Mamba next to attention), e.g. Qwen3.5 / Qwen3-Next class.
- [penalty-shapes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/penalty-shapes/README.md): Pad the token tensors used by repetition, presence and frequency penalties to bucketed lengths, so a batch that uses penalties stops recompiling HPU graphs on every decode step. Affects: requests that set `repetition_penalty`, `presence_penalty` or `frequency_penalty` (performance).
- [logits-empty-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/logits-empty-guard/README.md): Skip the tensor-parallel logits gather when a step has no logits rows, so long prompts do not stop the engine. Affects: every model served with tensor parallelism and sync scheduling (`--no-async-scheduling`).
- [gather-logprobs-int32](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/gather-logprobs-int32/README.md): Cast logprob token ids to int32 before concatenating them, so `top_logprobs` ids read back correctly on HPU. Affects: every model, requests with `logprobs` / `top_logprobs` (and `prompt_logprobs`).
- [prompt-logprobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/prompt-logprobs/README.md): Make `prompt_logprobs` safe and correct in the HPU model runner: no engine crash on models with a flat hidden-state output, correct values, bounded memory. Affects: every model, requests with `prompt_logprobs` (or `/v1/completions` with `echo` and `logprobs`).
- [logprobs-decode-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/logprobs-decode-guard/README.md): Stop one undecodable logprob token id from shutting down the API server. Affects: every model, requests with `logprobs` / `top_logprobs`.
- [seeded-sampling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/seeded-sampling/README.md): Seeded random sampling on HPU without `torch.Generator` ops on the device, so a request with a `seed` cannot crash a worker, and seeded output does not depend on the batch. Affects: every model, requests with `seed` and temperature > 0.
- [topk-subset-sampler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/topk-subset-sampler/README.md): Top-k / top-p sampling on HPU without sorting the whole vocabulary on every decode step. Affects: every model, requests with `top_k` (with or without `top_p`), including defaults from `generation_config.json`.
- [sink-once](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/sink-once/README.md): Count attention sinks once per sequence in paged decode, and apply them in FusedSDPA prefill on v0.26.0. Affects: models with attention sinks (for example gpt-oss).
- [swa-decode-window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/swa-decode-window/README.md): Make the sliding window exact in paged decode for gpt-oss, instead of 129 to 256 visible tokens for a 128-token window. Affects: gpt-oss (20B and 120B).
- [moe-explicit-overload](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/moe-explicit-overload/README.md): Call the per-channel FP8 MoE op by its explicit overload, so it does not force a host sync per MoE layer. Affects: FP8 per-channel MoE models (for example FP8 Qwen3 MoE, GLM and DeepSeek checkpoints).
- [laguna-moe-sigmoid-routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/laguna-moe-sigmoid-routing/README.md): MoE top-k routing ignores `scoring_func`, the score correction bias and `renormalize`. Affects: MoE models with sigmoid scoring, an `e_score_correction_bias`, or `renormalize=False`.
- [fp8-moe-gather](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/fp8-moe-gather/README.md): Backport the gathered-expert FP8 MoE combine from vllm-gaudi v0.30.0 to v0.26.0: at low token counts only the routed experts are read and computed, which speeds up decode on fine-grained FP8 MoE models. Affects: block-quantized FP8 MoE checkpoints with dynamic activation scales and silu experts, for example Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 MoE FP8 (performance).
- [moe-router-weight-on-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/moe-router-weight-on-input/README.md): Apply the router weight to the expert input, not the output, for MoE layers that ask for it (`apply_router_weight_on_input`), as Llama 4 does. Affects: Llama 4 Scout and Maverick (BF16 and compressed-tensors checkpoints).
- [mm-merge-idxcopy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/mm-merge-idxcopy/README.md): Merge multimodal embeddings with `nonzero` + `index_copy_` instead of a broadcast `masked_scatter_` that fails to compile on Gaudi under concurrent image traffic. Affects: vision-language models (images or video).
- [rope-cpu-cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/rope-cpu-cache/README.md): Build rotary-embedding cos/sin tables on the CPU, because Gaudi fp32 cos/sin of large arguments are inaccurate. Affects: RoPE models served with long contexts (above about 128K positions).
- [rank-exception-fatal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/rank-exception-fatal/README.md): Stop the engine when a tensor-parallel worker fails a call whose result is read from another rank, instead of serving with the ranks out of step. Affects: every multi-card deployment that uses vLLM's multiprocessing executor (TP > 1, the default executor on one node).
- [vllm-long-prefill-share](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/vllm-long-prefill-share/README.md): Let long prompts take at most a set share of wall time while other requests decode, so one very long prefill does not stall every other stream. Affects: long-context deployments (hundreds of thousands of tokens) with chunked prefill and concurrent users.
- [structured-outputs-auto-whitespace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/structured-outputs-auto-whitespace/README.md): Allow `disable_any_whitespace` with the default `auto` structured-output backend, and make the outlines backend honour it. Affects: servers that want compact JSON from structured outputs (`disable_any_whitespace`).
- [xgrammar-generation-eos-stop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/xgrammar-generation-eos-stop/README.md): Let a completed grammar end the turn with the model's real end-of-turn tokens, not only the tokenizer's EOS. Affects: structured outputs and forced tool calls (xgrammar backend) on models whose turn ends with a token other than `tokenizer.eos_token_id`.
- [glm47-streaming-text-markers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/glm47-streaming-text-markers/README.md): Make the `glm47` tool parser recognise tool-call markers written as plain text when streaming, so streaming and non-streaming responses agree. Affects: GLM-4.7 and GLM-5 family models served with `--tool-call-parser glm47`, `stream: true`, forced tool calls.
- [gptoss-harmony-parse-recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/gptoss-harmony-parse-recovery/README.md): Keep a malformed gpt-oss message header from failing the whole request with HTTP 500, and keep the tool call it was meant to carry. Affects: gpt-oss (20B and 120B) with the harmony parser, mostly requests with tools.
- [gemma4-required-tool-grammar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/gemma4-required-tool-grammar/README.md): Make `tool_choice: "required"` and named tool choice produce a tool call with the `gemma4` tool parser. Affects: Gemma 4 models served with `--tool-call-parser gemma4` and forced tool choice.
- [gemma4-buffered-tool-args](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/gemma4-buffered-tool-args/README.md): Emit `gemma4` tool-call arguments once, complete, with spurious escapes removed. Affects: Gemma 4 models served with `--tool-call-parser gemma4` (code-editing and file-writing tools).
- [qwen3-strict-think-end](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/qwen3-strict-think-end/README.md): End Qwen3 reasoning only at `</think>`, so a tool-call example the model quotes while thinking is not returned as a real tool call. Affects: Qwen3-family models served with `--reasoning-parser qwen3` and tool calling, for example Qwen3.6-27B.
- [llama4-tools-lenient](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/llama4-tools-lenient/README.md): A tool-call parser plugin and chat template for Llama 4 that read every call syntax the model writes and render tool history the way the model expects. Affects: Llama 4 Scout and Maverick with tool calling.
- [gemma4-bos-tokenizer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/fixes/gemma4-bos-tokenizer/README.md): Build a tokenizer directory for Gemma 4 instruct checkpoints that adds `<bos>` to raw prompts, so `/v1/completions` works. Affects: Gemma 4 instruct checkpoints (`google/gemma-4-*-it`) served with `/v1/completions` or `/tokenize`.

## Kernels

- [Kernels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kernels/index.md): Custom TPC kernels for Gaudi 2.
- [MXFP4 MoE decode kernels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kernels/mxfp4-moe.md): Up to 3x faster MXFP4 MoE decode on Gaudi 2.

## Kubernetes

- [Kubernetes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/index.md): This section covers running vLLM on Gaudi at fleet scale on Kubernetes: what a Gaudi pod needs, how to place pods so cards do not fragment, how to start, drain, roll and autoscale model servers that take minutes to load, and how to notice when one stops working while still looking healthy.
- [Pod spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/pod-spec.md): What a vLLM pod on Gaudi needs, and why.
- [Scheduling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/scheduling.md): How to place Gaudi pods so the fleet does not fragment, and why model pods should never be pinned to nodes.
- [Start-up and warm-up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/startup-and-warmup.md): A model server's cold start decides how fast the fleet can react: how quickly an autoscaler can follow a burst, how long a rollout takes, and how much a node failure costs.
- [Health and failure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/health-and-failure.md): The failures that cost the most are the ones every layer reports as healthy.
- [Rollouts and scaling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/rollouts-and-scaling.md): Model servers take minutes to start and hold long streams open.
- [Routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/routing.md): How requests reach model pods matters as much as how many pods there are.
- [Observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thediymaker/gaudi-cookbook/main/docs/kubernetes/observability.md): What to scrape, what to alert on, and how to keep logs and Prometheus useful on a large fleet.
